method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- S1 (resource): name = "S1"; capacity = 60; delivery_days = 5; cost = 9000.
- S2 (resource): name = "S2"; capacity = 50; delivery_days = 6; cost = 8000.
- E3: required = 100; deadline_days = 7; budget = 20000; total_capacity = 110; max_delivery = 6; total_cost = 17000; capacity_gap = 10; time_slack = 1; budget_slack = 3000; status = "FEASIBLE".
- office wifi: name = "office wifi".
Links:
- S1 → E3 (supports).
- S2 → E3 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- total_capacity of E3 = the sum of capacity over all entities with an influencing link into E3 (0 if there are none).
- max_delivery of E3 = the max of delivery_days over all entities with an influencing link into E3 (0 if there are none).
- total_cost of E3 = the sum of cost over all entities with an influencing link into E3 (0 if there are none).
- capacity_gap of E3 = (total_capacity of E3 − required of E3).
- time_slack of E3 = (deadline_days of E3 − max_delivery of E3).
- budget_slack of E3 = (budget of E3 − total_cost of E3).
- status of E3 is "FEASIBLE" if ((total_capacity of E3 ≥ required of E3) and (max_delivery of E3 ≤ deadline_days of E3) and (total_cost of E3 ≤ budget of E3)); "BORDERLINE" if ((total_capacity of E3 ≥ (0.9 × required of E3)) and (max_delivery of E3 ≤ deadline_days of E3) and (total_cost of E3 ≤ budget of E3)); otherwise "INFEASIBLE".
